case.given: A Component or Capsule occurrence is resting, hovered, keyboard-focused, selected, touched, explicitly overridden or policy-restricted.
case.when: The default mode-aware shell presents its mode affordance at wide or narrow width.
case.then: The shell SHALL keep identity and mode controls out of normal document flow, reveal one compact accessible trigger through progressive disclosure, expose View/Edit/Inherit and policy detail in a contextual menu, preserve an unobtrusive explicit-overlay indicator, and SHALL cause no content displacement or alternate transition authority.
